b_claim_survival.how_to_measure: share of this generation's claims still SUPPORTED/PARTIALLY at the audit two generations later; fill after G(n+2)

d_retraction_propagation.how_to_measure: of claims this generation retired, share still cited live in its own later files (grep)

e_evidence_reproducibility.how_to_measure: share of Tier-A/OBSERVED claims the next auditor reproduced from primary sources

h_base_rates_measured.how_to_measure: number of detection signals with a measured benign-population rate in the framework text
h_base_rates_measured.note: V4 attaches a base-rate NOTE (benign population named) to every signal but MEASURES none; recorded honestly as 0. A generation that measures even one benign-cohort rate will beat both G0 and G1 on this metric.

a_descriptive_coverage.how_to_measure: share of window incidents >= $1M mapping to an existing category without creating a new one
a_descriptive_coverage.note: Not meaningful for the window V4 was built on (coverage is trivially high by construction). G2 measures V4's coverage of the 2026-10-01 -> next-audit window.

d_hindsight_ratio.note: reports/model_comparison.md section 12.6: roughly one third of the V3->V4 delta available on G0's own evidence (reasoning), two thirds required the window (hindsight). Self-reported; G2 re-rates.
